For each free coordinate j the root-character tangent weight chi_j(b)=-r_1...r_j(alpha_{i_j}) and total c1 weight S(b)=sum_j chi_j(b) produce degree d via componentwise vector identity S(b)-S(b^j)=d chi_j(b). An independent exact integer-permutation and weight implementation verified all 4096 vertices, all 24576 edges, opposite endpoint tangent directions and every component of the displayed degree identity, obtaining multiplicities -2:512, 0:4096, 2:15360, 4:4096, 6:512. The b=516 to 517 edge has d=-2. This proves -K not nef provided the cited tower-chart/tangent-character realization of the Richardson is as described. The source structural identification is a necessary geometric premise, not established by numeric checks alone.
